sector_kpis.norm_warning: compressing while ASP rises = cost absorption failing

valuation.conventions: Compare within segment only (PV vs PV, CV vs CV). CV and tractors are deep-cyclical: normalize earnings to mid-cycle before multiple framing. Tractor/rural franchises carry structural premium for lower cyclicality. Where the market applies SOTP for EV subsidiaries or stakes, note that the market is doing so — never construct your own SOTP.

overlays.business_model: Sector model: cyclical assembler capturing brand + distribution margin; profit = volume x (realization - RM basket) - fixed-cost absorption. Healthy OEMs run NEGATIVE working capital (dealer advances, supplier credit) - report WC sign and trend. Unit economics = per-vehicle realization and EBITDA/vehicle. Revenue quality: order-backlog-backed for launch-driven models, else transactional-cyclical.
overlays.financials: D1: growth MUST decompose volume x realization x mix (all published for OEMs) and compare vs SIAM/FADA segment prints for share math. RM basket = steel, aluminium, copper, plastics/crude derivatives, precious metals (catalysts); margin bridge vs commodity index with 1-2 quarter lag (contract resets). Watch other income: customer-advance float (tractors/2W, EV bookings). D2: dealer/channel financing recourse if disclosed; platform capex Rs 1,500-4,000 cr - peak-capex years depress ROCE, normalize before judging; capitalized R&D % vs expensed - aggressive capitalizers flatter PAT, compare policy across OEMs. D3: customer advances can swell CFO - strip to judge underlying conversion.
overlays.supply_chain: Input basket: steel (body/chassis), aluminium (castings, EV push increases share), copper (wiring, EV multiplies), rare-earth magnets (EV traction motors - China single-source risk is live), semiconductors (2021 shortage archetype), precious metals (catalysts, ICE only). Check: import % of RM, semiconductor sourcing arrangements, battery-cell sourcing for EV lines (cell import vs local assembly vs captive).
overlays.governance: Sector-typical: royalty payments to foreign parent/tech partners (trend as % of sales; hikes without shareholder approval history); dealer-network related parties; EV subsidiary structures (minority dilution of the growth asset - who owns the EV entity?).
overlays.peers: Compare within segment. ASP and EBITDA/vehicle comparisons only meaningful within similar mix. Share data from SIAM (wholesale) vs FADA (retail) - never mix the two in one comparison; state which.
overlays.risks: Sector signatures: demand cyclicality by segment (tractor=monsoon/rural cash; CV=freight economics+IIP; PV=urban income+financing; 2W=rural+entry-level stress); EV transition cannibalization of ICE cash cows; discount wars when channel inventory >45-50 days; commodity spikes with pass-through lag; regulatory shifts (emission-norm steps = pre-buy then demand hole, safety mandates = cost adds); EV subsidy dependence.
overlays.industry: Cadence: monthly volumes (1st), SIAM ~10th, FADA ~5th-8th. Festive (Oct-Nov) = 35-40% of annual PV/2W retail. Monsoon (Jun-Sep) drives tractor H2. Price hikes cluster Jan/Apr. Commodity contracts reset quarterly. Emission/safety norm dates are demand-shape events.
overlays.valuation: Cyclicals: state cycle position from C before percentile framing; low P/E on peak CV/tractor earnings is the classic trap - always show normalized-earnings context for CV/tractor-heavy names.
overlays.takeaways: Monitorables vocabulary: next monthly SIAM/FADA print, festive-season retail, channel inventory days, EV mix trajectory, commodity reset direction, monsoon progress (tractor names).

forensic_signatures: Discounts hidden in 'marketing expense' vs netted from revenue - check accounting-policy note when comparing margins across OEMs
Dealer stuffing: wholesale >> retail for 2+ quarters, especially before fiscal year-end
Warranty provision adequacy vs recall history
Royalty to parent rising faster than revenue
Capitalized R&D share rising while reported margins hold
classic_mistakes: Judging demand from wholesale (SIAM) alone - retail (FADA) minus wholesale is the channel truth
Crediting EV optionality while ignoring near-term EV margin drag and ICE melt rate
Treating tractor cyclicality (monsoon/rural cash) like CV cyclicality (freight+IIP) - different clocks
Comparing ASP across different segment mixes
